## `core`

Self-check: connectivity, auth, Groovy endpoint, toolsets.

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `jira_analyst_status` | Check connectivity, auth, the Groovy endpoint and enabled toolsets. |

## `admin`

Workflows (+ raw XML, transition conditions/validators/post-functions), screens, permission/notification/workflow/field-config/issue-security schemes, groups, roles, licensing, cluster, reindex.

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `jira_get_application_properties` | Global settings: time tracking, attachment limits, voting, watching, subtasks. |
| `jira_get_cluster_info` | DC cluster: is clustered, node count, each node ID/state/IP, current node flag. |
| `jira_get_custom_field` | Custom field with ALL contexts and project/issue-type scope. |
| `jira_get_field_config_scheme` | Issue type → field configuration mappings. |
| `jira_get_field_configuration` | Per-field settings: hidden, required, renderer, description override. |
| `jira_get_group_members` | Group members — username, display name, email, active flag. |
| `jira_get_issue_security_scheme` | All security levels with their access grants (users, groups, roles). |
| `jira_get_notification_scheme` | All event-to-recipient mappings for the scheme. |
| `jira_get_permission_scheme` | All permission grants (permission key, grant type, grant value). |
| `jira_get_project_config` | Full project admin view — all assigned schemes, roles with members, components, versions. |
| `jira_get_project_role_members` | Users and groups assigned to a role in the given project. |
| `jira_get_reindex_status` | Get the current or last Jira reindex progress — is indexing running, stuck, or done. |
| `jira_get_screen` | Screen tabs with their fields (id, name, position). |
| `jira_get_server_info` | Jira version, build number, base URL, title. |
| `jira_get_user` | Display name, email, active, groups, application roles (Software/JSM/Core). |
| `jira_get_workflow` | Get workflow structure — steps with linked statuses, global actions, transitions. |
| `jira_get_workflow_scheme` | Default workflow and issue type → workflow mappings. |
| `jira_get_workflow_transition` | Conditions tree, validators, pre/post-functions with class names and parameters. |
| `jira_get_workflow_xml` | Raw OSWorkflow XML — for deep inspection, migration, or diffing. |
| `jira_list_application_roles` | License tiers with seat usage — critical for capacity audits. |
| `jira_list_custom_field_types` | Available custom field types — essential for building admin ТЗ. |
| `jira_list_dashboards` | All shared dashboards — name, owner, favourite count, system default. |
| `jira_list_event_types` | All event types — maps event IDs in notification schemes to human-readable names. |
| `jira_list_field_config_schemes` | Field-config schemes with associated projects. |
| `jira_list_field_configurations` | Field configurations — id, name, isDefault, field count. |
| `jira_list_global_permissions` | Who has SYSTEM_ADMIN, ADMINISTER, USE, BULK_CHANGE, etc. |
| `jira_list_groups` | List all groups with member counts. |
| `jira_list_issue_link_types` | All link types — name, inward/outward descriptions. |
| `jira_list_issue_security_schemes` | All issue security schemes with associated project keys. |
| `jira_list_issue_type_schemes` | Default issue type, mapped types, associated projects. |
| `jira_list_issue_type_screen_schemes` | Maps issue types to screen schemes. |
| `jira_list_issue_types` | All issue types — id, name, description, isSubtask, icon. |
| `jira_list_notification_schemes` | List all notification schemes with associated project keys. |
| `jira_list_permission_schemes` | List all permission schemes with associated project keys. |
| `jira_list_priority_schemes` | Priority schemes (Jira 10.x). Error hint if not available. |
| `jira_list_project_categories` | Project categories — used to group projects. |
| `jira_list_project_roles` | All project roles — id, name, description. |
| `jira_list_projects` | Projects with key, name, lead, category, assigned permission/workflow schemes. |
| `jira_list_reference_data` | All statuses (with categories), priorities, resolutions. |
| `jira_list_screen_schemes` | Maps operations (Create/Edit/View) to screens. |
| `jira_list_screens` | List all field screens — id, name, description, tab count. |
| `jira_list_shared_filters` | All shared filters — name, JQL, owner, favourite count. |
| `jira_list_workflow_schemes` | List all workflow schemes with associated project keys. |
| `jira_list_workflows` | List all Jira workflows with step counts and last-updated dates. |
| `jira_my_permissions` | Check which permissions the authenticated user has on a project or issue. |

## `scriptrunner`

Listeners, behaviours, scripted fields, fragments, jobs, REST endpoints, escalation services — with full Groovy source.

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `jira_get_sr_behaviour` | FULL Groovy per field — server-side validation, initialisers, conditions. |
| `jira_get_sr_escalation_service` | Full JQL, cron schedule, transition/script actions, enabled state. |
| `jira_get_sr_listener` | FULL Groovy script + event bindings for a single listener. |
| `jira_get_sr_script_field` | FULL Groovy, template type, caching config, preview issue. |
| `jira_list_sr_behaviours` | Form behaviours — id, name, disabled, field count (no scripts). |
| `jira_list_sr_endpoints` | Custom REST endpoints found under JIRA_HOME/scripts — name, method, preview. |
| `jira_list_sr_escalation_services` | JQL-based scheduled rules that auto-transition or modify issues. |
| `jira_list_sr_fragments` | Web items, panels, sections, and show/hide conditions injected into the UI. |
| `jira_list_sr_jobs` | Scheduled jobs — name, cron, last run, script file, enabled state. |
| `jira_list_sr_listeners` | Listeners with events, script file, enabled state, projects, inline scripts. |
| `jira_list_sr_script_fields` | Scripted fields — field name, template, hasInlineScript, scriptFile path. |

## `jmwe`

JMWE event-based and shared actions.

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `jira_get_jmwe_event_action` | Full config — trigger, scope, JQL, Groovy condition, post-functions with classes + JSON. |
| `jira_get_jmwe_shared_action` | All getters from the AO entity — config JSON, inline Groovy, run-as user. |
| `jira_list_jmwe_event_actions` | JMWE event-based actions — trigger event, project scope, JQL, condition, post-functions. |
| `jira_list_jmwe_shared_actions` | Reusable post-functions, conditions, validators referenced from workflow transitions. |

## `structure`

ALM Works Structure + Structure.Gantt.

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `jira_get_gantt_calendar` | Working days, holidays, work hours. |
| `jira_get_gantt_config` | Gantt config — date fields, progress, dependencies, calendar, leveling, baseline. |
| `jira_get_gantt_schedule` | Calculated dates, critical path, dependencies, baselines. |
| `jira_get_structure` | Name, description, owner, row count, generator configuration. |

| `jira_list_structure_views` | Structure views — id, name, owner, shared, column count. |
| `jira_list_structures` | Structure plugin hierarchies — id, name, description, owner, archived state. |

## `assets`

Insight / Assets CMDB: schemas, object types, AQL, imports.

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `jira_aql_search` | Search Assets objects using AQL. Returns object key, label, type. |
| `jira_get_asset_object` | All attributes with values, referenced objects, object type, timestamps. |
| `jira_get_object_connected_tickets` | Jira issues connected to an Assets object — CMDB ↔ issue relationships. |
| `jira_get_object_schema` | Schema metadata + object-type hierarchy. |
| `jira_get_object_type_attributes` | All attributes — data type, required, cardinality, reference type for links. |
| `jira_list_import_configs` | LDAP/CSV/DB syncs with cron schedules and last execution — where CMDB data comes from. |
| `jira_list_object_schemas` | All Insight/Assets object schemas. |
| `jira_list_object_types` | Object types in the schema — name, parent, object count, abstract flag. |
| `jira_list_reference_types` | Relationship kinds between objects (Dependency, Installed on, Uses, …). |
| `jira_list_status_types` | Object lifecycle states (Active, Inactive, Pending) with categories. |

## `integrations`

UPM plugins and modules, webhooks, application links, dark features.

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `jira_get_plugin` | Single plugin details — UPM ``/rest/plugins/1.0/{key}-key``. |
| `jira_get_plugin_modules` | Enabled/disabled modules for a plugin (completeKey, type, name). |
| `jira_list_application_links` | Application links to Confluence/Bitbucket/other (admin-only). |
| `jira_list_dark_features` | Dark-features toggles via ``/rest/internal/1.0/darkFeatures``. |
| `jira_list_plugins` | Installed plugins via Universal Plugin Manager (SYS_ADMIN required). |
| `jira_list_webhooks` | List instance webhooks. |

## `issue_inspect`

Attachment content (vision + text), thumbnails, votes, remote links.

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `jira_get_attachment_content` | Download an attachment and return it inline for analysis. |
| `jira_get_attachment_thumbnail` | Fetch the server-generated thumbnail for an image attachment. |
| `jira_get_issue_remotelinks` | External links attached to an issue — ``/rest/api/2/issue/{key}/remotelink``. |
| `jira_get_issue_votes` | Total votes and (where visible) voter list for an issue. |

## `dvcs`

DVCS orgs/repos/sync audit, Git Integration (BigBrassBand), dev-status panel.

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `jira_get_dvcs_organization` | Get full configuration of one DVCS organization. |
| `jira_get_dvcs_repository` | Get one DVCS-linked repository by id — slug, sync settings, activity timestamps. |
| `jira_get_dvcs_sync_audit` | Diagnose why the Git dev panel isn't updating — DVCS sync audit log. |
| `jira_get_gij_commit_issues` | Find which Jira issues a commit is linked to — reverse commit→issue lookup. |
| `jira_get_issue_dev_detail` | Get the full Git dev-panel detail for an issue — raw commits / branches / PRs. |
| `jira_get_issue_dev_summary` | Summary of the Git dev panel on an issue — counts of PRs/MRs, branches, commits, repositories. |
| `jira_list_dvcs_organizations` | List connected DVCS organizations (GitHub / GitLab / Bitbucket). |
| `jira_list_dvcs_repositories` | List repositories synced from a DVCS organization. |
| `jira_list_gij_issue_branches` | List Git branches linked to a Jira issue via the BigBrassBand plugin. |
| `jira_list_gij_issue_commits` | List Git commits linked to a Jira issue via the BigBrassBand plugin. |

## `sla`

Time to SLA (Appfire/SaaSJet).

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `jira_list_sla_calendars` | List work calendars used for SLA calculations — working days, hours, holidays. |
| `jira_list_sla_definitions` | List all SLA definitions configured by the Time to SLA plugin. |
| `jira_search_sla_status` | Per-issue SLA status across a JQL result set. |

## `time_in_status`

Timepiece — Time in Status (OBSS).

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `jira_get_issue_time_in_status` | Get time-in-status breakdown for one issue — how long it sat in each status. |
| `jira_list_tis_calendars` | List work calendars configured for Time-in-Status reports. |
| `jira_search_time_in_status` | Run a bulk time-in-status report across a JQL — per-issue, average, or sum. |

## `email`

Email This Issue (JETI) audit log and mail queues.

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `jira_get_jeti_audit_count` | Count JETI audit-log entries matching a filter — cheap sanity check. |
| `jira_get_jeti_generation_queue_stats` | Spot bottlenecks between JETI event firing and email send — template-rendering queue. |
| `jira_get_jeti_incoming_queue_stats` | Diagnose inbound JETI mail handlers — are they processing or stuck. |
| `jira_get_jeti_outgoing_queue_stats` | Diagnose "JETI emails aren't arriving" — outbound mail queue stats. |
| `jira_search_jeti_audit_log` | Find who received what email for a Jira issue and when. |
